text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Dad, Mom, Sensei, everyone. I'm sorry if 
this sudden letter caught you by 
surprise."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"‘Everyone told me from the start that 
they'd come to cheer me on, but...’"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to invite you properly, so I 
took up my pen."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"The Sprinters Stakes. Please, come watch 
me at Nakayama Racecourse."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Many girls will be running. The strongest 
rivals whose strength and speed I know all 
too well."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"And then, there's also that girl they 
call the 'Genius Girl' running, who's 
already won two GⅠs."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Fast, strong, and dignified."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"There will surely be girls in the 
upcoming race with the kind of speed that 
could redefine the era."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Still, I won't lose."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"‘I will definitely win. I'll win and 
become the fastest of this era.’"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Please, watch. The culmination of all the 
miracles you gave us."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "To the brightest, most radiant place."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Please, let everyone who watches it 
smile."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"To become that kind of miracle. That's 
why I'll run."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (...The same dim morning as always.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Alright.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Miracle-san.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Ruby. Are you heading to morning 
practice now?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Then I'm meeting my Trainer at the school 
gates anyway... Wanna walk to the academy 
together?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...No, I will see you off here. Have a 
safe trip.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep training on my end... and await 
your return.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ruby...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I promise I'll win and come back.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, there you are!! Mornin', Miracle!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo! Good morning. Hehe, it's always 
great to see you so energetic in the 
morning.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe~! Well, it was definitely worth the 
wait!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh? You were waiting for me? *Me*?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes, sir! Today's the big match, after 
all. ...Which means...!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Let's go! Let's go! Miracle!! Do your best 
in the Sprinters Stakesーーー!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...! Ahaha... Thanks, Bamboo!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Nah! ...Though I told Helios and Zephyr 
the same thing.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Don't you dare lose, any of you!! —Because 
next time, you've gotta race against me!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Yeah.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ...I won't lose!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah... good morning, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: No, not at all. ...Well then, shall we go?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Toward our Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(I head straight to Nakayama Racecourse, 
together with Trainer, who seems a little 
nervous again today.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(My body feeling warm like this... must be 
because the heat is closing in.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(...Is this a reflection of how I really 
feel?)

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
And now, at Nakayama Racecourse, the start 
of today's main race, the Sprinters 
Stakes, is finally drawing near!

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
The race that signals the start of the 
autumn GⅠ season... Far more spectators 
than usual are in the stands, eagerly 
awaiting the moment of battle!

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
Let's hear a few words from our contender. 
...Hello! The Sprinters Stakes is finally 
about to begin, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Woman in a Blue Scarf
text_block_list.text:
Yes! For so long... for so very long, I 
have looked forward to this day. The day 
she shines crowned as the "Fastest."

text_block_list.name: Man in Red Hat
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like attendance is going up, 
too!! I really want people to witness it. 
The sheer intensity of sprint races!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Once we get to the racecourse, the rest 
will fly by in an instant.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Getting ready in the waiting room. 
Finishing the final check with Trainer.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(The chilly, clear, yet heavy and unique 
atmosphere of the underground tunnel.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(To think the day would come when it feels 
natural to my body. ...I never could have 
imagined it.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Still—)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah... M-Miracle-san!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um...! I look forward to working with you 
today.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I'm happy to be running with you. I've 
always thought you were really fast, 
Miracle..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'll do my best not to lose today, too!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Flower... yeah, thank you. It's an honor 
to hear that from you."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'll pour all my joy into my running. I'll 
do my best too, Flower.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hey hey heeeey!! Are you hyped uuuup!?!?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Helios, Zephyr! Hehe, yeah, I'm super 
hyped. How about you two?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Totes!!! And cue the Wooohooo~~~~☆

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course. ...However.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Look, Miracle-san. Today's greatest... 
tempest is coming from over there.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O. ...Today is finally the day.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ......Hmm, I see!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hm? ...What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No! I've heard that in times like this, 
you shouldn't say much and just... make a 
sleek, cool exit, but still!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
But I felt like saying it!! So I'm just 
going to say it!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: K.S.Miracle-saaaan!!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let's run! Let's dash through with 
everything we've got! And then, let's 
settle this!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In the simplest, most straightforward way 
possible!! In other words, is it me, or is 
it you?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Which one of us... reached the goal just 
that bit faster!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let's battle for the title of "fastest of 
our era"!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
There is no such thing as losing for me. 
Charging full speed ahead is the true mark 
of a king!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: —Nope.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: My "miracle" will overtake you.
